      "band": "Unranked",

    },

      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Standardness tweaks for witness version 2 outputs are subordinate to the consensus validation implementation."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches functional mining tests only to accommodate the new transaction rules.",
      "band": "Unranked",

      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "No changes to the p2p transport, protocol messages, or peer handling logic."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to src/rpc/ merely expose descriptor and transaction capabilities for CISA.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "RPC adjustments simply expose the underlying wallet and script functionality."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Functional and unit tests pin the CISA consensus, wallet, and descriptor behavior.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Tests cover specific feature behavior rather than generic test runner or framework infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Modifications in src/secp256k1/ import prototype aggregation modules specifically to support the BIP460 consensus proposal.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Not an upstream secp256k1 subtree sync or utility refactor, but vendoring prototype modules for the validation implementation."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Implements consensus script verification and parallel checkqueue aggregation for BIP460 CISA witness version 2 outputs.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Addresses the fundamental scaling limit where multi-input transactions require individual signatures per input, heavily penalizing multi-party protocols like CoinJoin and Payjoin. As a major proposed soft fork implementation, reaching consensus review and evaluating cryptographic correctness is strategically important."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds `cisa()` and `rawcisa()` descriptors, PSBT extensions, and wallet signing logic for half- and full-aggregation.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Provides reference signing support and descriptor tooling for aggregate signature spends. While valuable to validate protocol viability, it is prototype functionality tied to a regtest-only activation."
    }
  ],

    "security_stability": 1,

    "leverage": 1
  }
